purpose: Provide a separate fail-closed path for exact V166 shared-onset timing decisions at the actual reference-blind SplitMySong Guitar event neighborhoods when historical Demucs stem bytes cannot be reproduced exactly.

supersessionBoundary.statement: The prior 1805/1805 gate remains a valid failed diagnostic. This preregistration defines a distinct candidate-specific exact-support gate before any SplitMySong pitch inference is observed.

historicalSharedSupportTableRule.source: Only stepSelection.candidates rows already persisted in the frozen V166 candidate may contribute historical sharedSupport evidence.
historicalSharedSupportTableRule.value: the persisted sharedSupport for that step plus its persisted shared normalization beat/frame provenance
historicalSharedSupportTableRule.duplicateRule: Every repeated historical row for the same step must contain exactly the same numeric sharedSupport and compatible shared normalization provenance; otherwise fail closed.

splitMySongObservationRule.frontEnd: Exact frozen V166 Guitar front-end through admitted/recovered pre-grid events, with the already-frozen SplitMySong Guitar as the sole changed audio input.

requiredNeighborhoodRule.whenComputed: Only after the single reference-blind Basic Pitch observation has produced the frozen V166 pre-grid Guitar event list.
requiredNeighborhoodRule.preGridExclusion: Use the exact frozen V166 map_events pre-grid rule before constructing required timing neighborhoods.
requiredNeighborhoodRule.nearestStep: For each remaining pre-grid event, nearest is argmin(abs(latticeTime-eventTime)) using the exact frozen V166 timebase.
requiredNeighborhoodRule.candidateSteps: For each event, require every valid step in {nearest-1, nearest, nearest+1}.
requiredNeighborhoodRule.passCondition: Every required candidate step for every actual SplitMySong pre-grid Guitar event exists in the frozen historical shared-support table.
requiredNeighborhoodRule.failCondition: If even one required candidate step lacks a frozen historical sharedSupport row, stop before producing a mapped or final candidate.

exactMappingRule.sharedSupport: Use the exact persisted historical V166 sharedSupport for each required option step; do not use a newly separated Drums stem or a recomputed shared envelope.
exactMappingRule.instrumentSupport: Compute from the frozen SplitMySong Guitar onset envelope under the exact V166 beat_support_unit rule.
exactMappingRule.score: Use the exact frozen V166/V164 event_step_score formula and EVENT_NON_NEAREST_MARGIN behavior.
exactMappingRule.selection: Recompute nearest/winner deterministically from event time, frozen V166 lattice, new Guitar instrumentSupport, and exact historical sharedSupport lookup.
exactMappingRule.metadata: Preserve historical shared normalization provenance from the frozen support row and compute instrument normalization provenance from the SplitMySong Guitar envelope.
exactMappingRule.claim: A passing event is mapped with the same historical shared-support values that V166 would have supplied at every option step actually consulted by that event. No claim of full-WAV or full-lattice Demucs equivalence is made.

afterExactMappingPass: apply frozen I002 max_score_x_shared whole-stream transform
apply exact frozen I005 gss-active-only recovery/configuration
